prompts.core: Create an original fan-made pixel-art production sprite board of Pupa from Metal Gear Solid: Peace Walker for side-view 2D gameplay. Preserve its canonical unmanned low, broad, charcoal and rust-orange hovercraft/tank silhouette, rear cylindrical AI pod with red ring, armored skirt and compact weapon hardware. It must have no humanoid body and no legs. Fixed orthographic side view facing screen right. Exactly 4 columns by 4 rows with sixteen distinct authored poses: idle, hover movement, rear-thrust charge and canonical electrical/gun attacks. Flat pure #FF00FF background, exactly five cyan vertical and five horizontal guides including outside borders, safe empty margins, no text, logo, UI, scenery, watermark or unrelated machine.
prompts.special: Create the matching original fan-made Pupa special sprite board, preserving the exact same low hovercraft body, dark/rust palette, tall cylindrical AI pod and right-facing scale. Exactly 4 columns by 4 rows: recover, hit, disabled/death with the cylindrical pod tilting toward the ground, and scan. No legs or transformation into a walker. Flat #FF00FF, exactly five cyan guides per axis including borders, full actor contained in every cell, no text, logo, UI, scenery or watermark.
